instruments.notes: NYMEX-based crude oil swap; actual July and August settlements resulted in a $0.5 million payment to the counter-party
instruments.evidence_quote:
As of June 30, 1996, the Company had NYMEX-based crude oil swap agreements
for 1,000 Bbl per day for July 1, 1996 through August 31, 1996 at an average
price of $17.85 per Bbl.

instruments.notes: Counter-party option exercisable monthly for an additional 1,000 Bbl per day to cause a swap if the price exceeds an average $17.74 per Bbl; company estimates Sept-Dec hedges would be a $0.4 million payment to the counter-party

The counter-party has the option exercisable monthly
for an additional 1,000 Bbl per day for the period July 1, 1996 through December
31, 1996 to cause a swap if the price exceeds an average $17.74 per Bbl.
